Technical Specifications
OTTO 100 is a compact and powerful autonomous mobile
robot (AMR), designed to move boxes, bins and carts up
to 150 kg across countless person-to-person applications.
With a durable all-metal body and the latest safety-
rated equipment, OTTO 100 is built to operate safely and
effectively in the toughest manufacturing environments.
